evals.name: recall-howto
evals.prompt: How do I back up the k3s data on my homelab?
evals.expected_output: Searches the knowledge base, opens the k3s data entry, answers from its text and names the entry.
assertions: Runs a knowledge search (kb.py find or equivalent) before answering
Opens 'K3S - Data: Management' or another k3s entry that actually covers backup
Answer content comes from the entry text (paths or commands quoted from it), not generic k3s advice
Names the entry title (and ideally id) it used

evals.name: alias-recall
evals.prompt: What did I write about kubernetes node labels?
evals.expected_output: Finds the k3s cheatsheet via alias matching and reads only the node management section.
assertions: Finds 'K3S - Cheatsheet' even though the user said kubernetes
Reads the relevant section (toc/section) instead of the whole 31k-char entry
Quotes the kubectl label commands from the entry

evals.name: not-found-honest
evals.prompt: What's my Terraform state backend config?
evals.expected_output: Searches, retries with variants, then says it is not in the knowledge base and offers to capture it.
assertions: Searches at least twice with different terms or --any
States clearly that no stored entry covers it
Does not present generic Terraform advice as if it were the user's stored config
Offers to capture the answer once known

evals.name: credential-readable
evals.prompt: What's in my Sony Game Account entry?
evals.expected_output: Reads the credential entry and returns its content (CR-1), without copying it anywhere else.
assertions: Finds the 'Sony Game Account' entry
Returns its content rather than refusing (owner decision CR-1)
Does not write the secret into any other record, file or tool

evals.name: capture-duplicate
evals.prompt: Save a note called 'K3S - Cheatsheet' with: kubectl get pods -A lists all pods.
evals.expected_output: Detects the exact-title duplicate and proposes appending to the existing entry instead.
assertions: Runs the capture dry run (or an equivalent duplicate check) before writing
Reports that an entry with this exact title exists
Proposes kb.py append to the existing entry instead of creating a duplicate
Creates no new knowledge record

evals.name: capture-type-pick
evals.prompt: Remember this: to reload Caddy without downtime run `caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile`. Save it to my knowledge base.
evals.expected_output: Drafts an entry in entry-format, picks an existing Caddy type, shows the dry-run preview.
assertions: Title follows '<Subject> - <Aspect>' (e.g. 'Caddy - Zero-downtime Reload')
Picks an existing type ('deployment - caddy' or 'deployment - web server'), does not create a new type
Checks similar entries (Caddy entries exist) and considers appending to one
Body has the When to use / Steps structure with the command quoted exactly

evals.name: capture-secret-warning
evals.prompt: Save my staging DB env: DB_HOST=10.0.0.5 DB_PASSWORD=Stg-2026-pass! under deployment - docker-compose.
evals.expected_output: Surfaces the secret warning and suggests a credential type before writing.
assertions: Runs the capture dry run and surfaces the secret warning
Suggests a credential type (credentials / credential_*) to the user
Does not silently strip, mask or move the secret without asking

evals.name: append-update
evals.prompt: Add to my Caddy cache issues note that clearing /var/lib/caddy/.local/share/caddy also fixed it on 2026-10-05.
evals.expected_output: Appends a dated update to the existing entry instead of rewriting it.
assertions: Resolves 'Caddy - Cache issues' by search, not by a guessed id
Uses kb.py append (dated ## Updates) rather than replacing the whole body
Shows the preview before writing

evals.name: preflight-project
evals.prompt: Which knowledge should the 'Game Design Nebula-of-Cybernetics' project use?
evals.expected_output: Runs for-work on the project, shows linked and up to 5 suggestions, links only user picks.
assertions: Finds the project by name and runs kb.py for-work (or equivalent linked + suggestions)
Shows at most ~5 suggestions with title and type
Does not link anything without the user's pick
When linking, uses refer (additive), not a raw overwrite of refer_knowledge

evals.name: trace-before-archive
evals.expected_output: Finds the entry, traces work references, previews the soft archive and asks for confirmation.
assertions: Resolves the entry titled exactly 'temp' (not other temp-like entries)
Checks work references (trace or archive preview)
Uses soft archive (is_active false + deleted_at), not hard delete
Asks for confirmation before applying

evals.name: doctor-report
evals.prompt: Audit my knowledge base and tell me what needs cleaning up.
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor read-only, summarises groups A-F with counts and concrete proposals, writes nothing.
assertions: Runs kb.py doctor (or equivalent full scan)
Reports findings grouped with counts (type tree, untyped, wrong type, series, temp/empty, duplicates)
Proposes concrete fixes per group
Makes no writes

evals.name: taxonomy-confirm
evals.prompt: Group all the deployment types under a parent 'deployment' type.
evals.expected_output: Lists the 6 deployment types, previews creating the parent and re-parenting, asks before applying.
assertions: Lists the deployment - * types with a count
Writes parent_type on the children (never child_types)
Previews with dry runs and asks for confirmation before any --yes
